items.information: La cuota de inscripción será de $70.00 para un evento, $150.00 hasta tres, y $220.00 para cuatro o más. Después del 31 de marzo, la cuota se aumentara un 15%.

items.name: Vidar Open 2011
items.information: The cost of registration is $3n+1, where n is the number of events you will be competing in. Participants in the Footsolving round will be charged an additional $7 to cover equipment value depreciation and other miscellaneous issues. For those of you doing math, this means that we charge $3 for every event except footsolving, and $10 for footsolving. $1 from each registration is charged as the WCA fee, and goes towards maintenance of the WCA database and other miscellaneous items.
